format: html

```{r}
# 1) Last inn biblioteker ---------------------------------------------------
install.packages("rugarch")
install.packages("plm")
library(httr); library(jsonlite); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
library(lubridate); library(zoo); library(rugarch); library(plm)


# 2) Hent data (eksempel for én dag) ---------------------------------------
reservoirs <- GET("https://driftsdata.statnett.no/restapi/v1/reservoirs") %>%
  content(as = "text") %>% fromJSON(flatten = TRUE) %>%
  select(date = timestamp, name, filling) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

prices <- read.csv("nordpool_prices_2020_2025.csv") %>%
  mutate(datetime = ymd_hms(timestamp),
         date = as.Date(datetime),
         logprice = log(price))

weather <- read.csv("met_no_daily_2020_2025.csv") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
```
